policy.fields: All status/headers, JSON field presence/types/order, parser inputs/results, winning rules, decisions/memos, production request-builder inputs and emitted requests, JCP/ESML/analytics and complete session contents.
policy.generatedIDs: Bijective v4 envelope/session IDs and 32-hex JCP command IDs at command-container paths only; view/domain IDs stay literal.
policy.derivedBytes: Raw JSON, Content-Length and ETag are independently validated. Only validated duplicate raw bytes and ETag digest values are removed.
policy.timing: Per-request and per-case measured times are bounded; message timestamps and application timing fields remain compared.
policy.endpoints: Only the fixture peer authority in outbound Host headers is rebound.
policy.gaps: Unhosted cloud action targets are explicit coverage gaps and prevent a full gate pass.
